text:
```yaml
name: Java GSDK Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'java/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up JDK 8
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '8'
        distribution: 'temurin'
        cache: 'maven'
    
    - name: Build and test
      run: |
        cd java
        ./gradlew build :gameserverSDK:test
        
    - name: Publish Test Results
      uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
      if: always()
      with:
        files: java/gameserverSDK/build/test-results/test/*.xml
```
